about: Branch outcomes no input can reach, per equivalence case: proposed with the COBOL reason, reviewed by the owner in the PR that adds them, shown in the evidence report as stated assumptions. proof_blockers.py takes them out of the branch total; a det sweep whose proof reaches one fails (tests/tools/infeasible_outcomes.py). families.G: a guard every caller has already satisfied (data flow)
families.C: a test of a constant: a copybook VALUE never written, a table built once, a loop index with fixed bounds
families.R: a response the command never raises (IBM's documented conditions)
